name: Gou
source:
Major: Culinary
Gou is a simple fiery-type ripped right from a shounen manga. He's (sexually) obvious, focused solely on food (culinary), and is sickeningly energetic. 

When not eating, he plays forward for the school's basketball team which is how he got his scholarship. He is Aki's roomie and a Beta who lends his scene to protect Aki from hungry Alphas.
